# apipbx_webhook (Resource)

Posts a tenant's call.ended and voicemail.received events to a URL, signed with the secret (header X-Apipbx-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the body>). Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String)
- `url` (String) An http or https address. Private addresses are refused unless the platform allows them.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `events` (Set of String) call.ended and/or voicemail.received; both when left out.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) 16-128 characters; generated when left out.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
